B.E.S.T. Beginner to Expert Saturday Training

Chandler, AZ · North Chandler · Road

B.E.S.T. Beginner to Expert Saturday Training is a road group ride in Chandler, AZ. It rolls every Saturday at 7:30 am from Global Bikes & E-Bikes, North Chandler.

For visitors

Free, including the orientation. Bring a road bike or a hybrid with narrow tires, and a helmet. The host says someone will stay with you if you fall behind. Global Bikes has a ride waiver. The program's Strava club is invite-only. The event text still mentions an April orientation date, so the program seems to run more than once a year.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: beginner pace; distance builds from 10-15 miles in week one to 30 by the end. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the B.E.S.T. Beginner to Expert Saturday Training group ride

A free five-week program for new road cyclists, from the Global Bikes store in north Chandler. It starts with an evening orientation, then a Saturday ride each week that builds from 10 miles to 30. The shop says it also welcomes people coming back to cycling after a break.
